name: ABCO Automation Inc
old_description: With 47 years of experience in automation, ABCO has been at the forefront of the manufacturing industry since 1977.
about:
ABCO Automation Inc. was founded in 1977 by Graham Ricks in Browns Summit, North Carolina. The company began by providing electrical control systems and custom packaging equipment to Coca-Cola, and early innovations in labeling and filling led to significant growth throughout the 1980s. In the mid-1990s, ABCO transitioned to an employee-owned ESOP structure, a model the leadership credits for a highly motivated workforce.

Today, ABCO operates two facilities in Browns Summit: a Design Build Complex and a Contract Manufacturing & Assembly Center. The company delivers custom automation solutions through four core service lines: Design Build, Build to Print, Contract Manufacturing, and Robot Automation. Its engineering and manufacturing capabilities span mechanical and electrical design, fabrication, welding, assembly, kitting, inspection, laser marking, machining, machine tending, dispensing, and material handling integration. The firm serves clients ranging from Fortune 500 corporations to start-ups.

ABCO's industry focus includes food and beverage, logistics, life sciences, AgriTech, and healthcare. Long-standing relationships with major food and beverage brands such as Coca-Cola illustrate its experience with filling systems, packaging, and palletizing. The company also supports logistics automation with robotic palletizing, case packing, and conveyor systems, and provides precision automation for life sciences and medical device manufacturing.

The company emphasizes a single-source, turnkey approach backed by decades of mechanical and electrical engineering expertise. Its stated mission is to provide a single source for innovative automation services and manufacturing support that contribute to client success, guided by core values that prioritize client needs, integrity, excellence, and teamwork.
